title: Characterization of diphenyl phthalate as an agonist for estrogen receptor: an in vitro and in silico study.
authors: Lv, Chengyu; Wei, Zhengyi; Yue, Benjie; Xia, Ning; Huang, Wei; Yue, Yulan; Li, Zhuolin; Li, Tiezhu; Zhang, Xiuxia; Wang, Yongjun
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过体外实验和分子对接表征邻苯二甲酸二苯酯作为雌激素受体激动剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为小分子-受体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Phthalate esters (PAEs) are important pollutants in the environment, which can interfere with the endocrine system by mimicking estrogen. However, limited information is available on modulating the estrogen receptor (ER) of five PAEs including di (2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP), diisononyl phthalate (DINP), benzyl butyl phthalate (BBP), diphenyl phthalate (DPhP) and dicyclohexyl phthalate (DCHP). This study evaluated the agonistic effects of PAEs on human ER. The cytotoxicity assay showed that there were a significant inhibition of the cell proliferation with treatment of five PAEs. Moreover, DPhP does-dependently enhanced ER-mediated transcriptional activity in the reporter gene assay. The increased expression of estrogen-responsive genes (TFF1, CTSD, and GREB1) was also observed in MCF-7 cells treated with DPhP. The result of molecular docking showed that DPhP tended to bind to the agonist conformation of ER compared with the antagonist conformation of ER, demonstrating its agonist characteristic that has been confirmed in the reporter gene assay. Thus, we found that DPhP may be evaluated as an ER agonist in vitro and it can interfere with the normal function of human ER.
abstract_zh: 邻苯二甲酸酯（PAEs）是环境中的重要污染物，可通过模拟雌激素干扰内分泌系统。然而，关于五种PAEs（包括邻苯二甲酸二(2-乙基己基)酯（DEHP）、邻苯二甲酸二异壬酯（DINP）、邻苯二甲酸苄基丁基酯（BBP）、邻苯二甲酸二苯酯（DPhP）和邻苯二甲酸二环己酯（DCHP））调节雌激素受体（ER）的信息有限。本研究评估了PAEs对人ER的激动效应。细胞毒性实验显示，五种PAEs处理显著抑制了细胞增殖。此外，在报告基因实验中，DPhP剂量依赖性地增强了ER介导的转录活性。在DPhP处理的MCF-7细胞中，还观察到雌激素响应基因（TFF1、CTSD和GREB1）表达的增加。分子对接结果表明，与ER的拮抗构象相比，DPhP倾向于结合ER的激动构象，这证实了其在报告基因实验中已确认的激动特性。因此，我们发现DPhP在体外可能被评估为ER激动剂，并能干扰人ER的正常功能。
